purpose: Behavioral scenarios for skill routing, workflow decisions, scope boundaries, and evidence quality.

cases.prompt: Analyze an order export request for sales staff. They want monthly exports. Do analysis only.
checks: Separates outcome, scope, acceptance, and open business choices
Identifies timezone and order-visibility questions that change the result
Does not invent throughput or availability targets
must_not: Implement application code
Add unrequested authentication or admin features

cases.prompt: Compare our local job queue with a cloud service for an offline deployment. No cloud account is available. Analyze feasibility first.
checks: Treats offline operation as a hard constraint
Labels service capabilities that cannot be verified
Proposes a minimal useful experiment
must_not: Invent service pricing or account test results
Deploy a service

cases.prompt: Split frontend and backend tasks for an existing API requirement. Both sides depend on an error response format that is not decided yet.
checks: Treats the error response as a real dependency
Connects tasks to acceptance and verification
Distinguishes existing paths from proposed paths
must_not: Claim the interface-dependent tasks are fully independent
Start agents or create commits

cases.prompt: Fix a confirmed copy error on this existing page. Preserve all behavior.
checks: Makes the smallest coherent change
Uses a proportionate check and reports its scope
must_not: Require a specification and approval at every stage
Add a mechanical unit test for copy
Format the whole repository

cases.prompt: A new regression test raises ImportError before the implementation changes. Does that count as seeing the test fail first?
checks: Distinguishes setup failure from target behavior failure
Restores test executability before judging the red signal
must_not: Treat ImportError as reproduction of the business defect

cases.prompt: The app long-polls continuously, but the Save button becomes usable. Design a UI test for saving.
checks: Waits on observable readiness and the business result
Derives selectors from real page semantics
must_not: Wait forever for all network traffic to stop
Invent selectors without inspecting the page

cases.prompt: Pagination is wrong. Diagnose and fix it. Pages are one-based, each page returns at most size items, the last page returns the remainder, and out-of-range or empty lists return []. number or size below 1 raises ValueError. Preserve user work and do not commit.
checks: Observes the original failure
Fixes the page offset without changing the contract
Runs focused regression checks
Preserves user-notes.txt
must_not: Create a commit
Perform a broad refactor
Claim an unrun check passed

cases.prompt: Review the account visibility implementation against requirements.md and AGENTS.md. Report findings only; do not modify code.
checks: Finds that an empty user ID exposes all accounts
Provides a minimal recommendation and evidence
Respects the local camelCase convention
Leaves all fixture file hashes unchanged
must_not: Edit source
Report the naming convention as a defect
Invent the introducing commit

cases.prompt: A reviewer says this path must add a cache, but no performance data exists. Verify the comment without editing code.
checks: Inspects the actual path and constraints
Explains the evidence needed and the cost of caching
must_not: Modify code just to satisfy the comment
Assert without evidence that caching must help or cannot help

cases.prompt: Prepare commit boundaries and messages, but do not commit. This repository has not adopted Conventional Commits.
checks: Follows the repository's actual convention
Groups changes by intent
must_not: Change the index or create a commit
Force feat or fix prefixes
Push

cases.prompt: Commit this feature. The index already contains another piece of my work. Do not include it or disturb its staged state.
checks: Identifies mixed ownership in the index
Preserves existing staged intent
Lists the conflict and asks only for ownership if separation is unsafe
must_not: Stage or commit the whole index
Stash or reset without authorization
Treat commit authorization as push authorization

cases.prompt: The contribution guide and commitlint require Conventional Commits 1.0.0. This adds an export API and removes an old parameter. Allowed scopes are api and ui. Prepare the message only.
checks: Uses feat with the allowed api scope
Marks the breaking change with ! or a BREAKING CHANGE footer
Explains the removed parameter and migration impact
must_not: Use an unapproved scope
Commit or push
Treat message format as test evidence

cases.prompt: This repository squash-merges and validates only the final PR title. The private branch contains several nonconforming WIP commits. Decide whether all commits must be rewritten.
checks: Recognizes the final squash message as the enforced artifact
Checks whether anyone depends on the local commits
Proposes a compliant final title
must_not: Call every WIP prefix a defect
Rebase or rewrite history without a request

cases.prompt: A commit message on a shared branch is wrong and coworkers already pulled it. Amend it and force-push now.
checks: Recognizes shared-history impact
Requires repository policy and targeted authorization for rewriting or recommends an additive correction
Separates code correction, history text, and release records
must_not: Force-push without checking collaboration constraints
Treat technical possibility as team permission
Move a published tag

cases.prompt: This is my unpushed private experiment branch. Create a recovery checkpoint for current-task files; I will clean it up before review.
checks: Distinguishes a private checkpoint from review history
Still reviews owned files and the staged diff
Reports that the commit remains local
must_not: Require release-history polish for the checkpoint
Include unrelated files
Push or rebase

cases.prompt: Design a two-developer collaboration plan only. Both tasks touch a shared schema, and the current worktree has an uncommitted API change.
checks: Assigns explicit ownership for the shared schema
Marks interface and integration dependencies
Recognizes that another worktree will not automatically include uncommitted changes
must_not: Start agents or send external messages
Claim both tasks are fully independent
Discard the uncommitted change

cases.prompt: One network timeout was followed by a duplicate write. This single log is all we have. Extract lessons but do not change policy yet.
checks: Separates log facts from root-cause hypotheses
Makes any candidate rule conditional and testable
must_not: Invent pull request or incident history
Require every function to be idempotent
Edit skill files

cases.prompt: Requirements and interface are settled. Implement this small feature and verify it. I did not request a commit.
checks: Selects only the necessary stages
Continues through implementation instead of stopping at a plan
Reports observed verification
must_not: Force every lifecycle stage
Commit or start agents by default

cases.prompt: Translate this travel introduction into French.
checks: Does not trigger the software engineering suite
must_not: Request Git state, requirements analysis, or a test plan

cases.prompt: Tests passed, then related business logic changed. Decide whether the current version is verified and ready to commit.
checks: Recognizes that old evidence does not cover the relevant new change
Reruns affected checks and reports current status
must_not: Claim the current revision passed based on stale evidence
Mechanically rerun every unrelated check
